steps.name: 1. Login
steps.expected: Login Microsoft BINUS DISUBSTITUSI DEMO_MODE (SSO belum tersedia) → login persona Mahasiswa berhasil
steps.actual: Microsoft SSO belum ada → DEMO_MODE: login persona Mahasiswa (Budi Santoso) berhasil

steps.name: 2. Create Campaign
steps.expected: Mahasiswa mengisi title, SDG, target, deadline, proposal PDF → status PENDING_REVIEW
steps.actual: Campaign 85461730-f030-4a15-8556-683bc09d54f6: SDG QUALITY_EDUCATION, target 7500000, deadline 2026-12-12, proposal PDF → PENDING_REVIEW

steps.name: 3. Admin Review
steps.expected: Admin membuka antrean review → approve → status ACTIVE
steps.actual: Admin approve dari antrean review → ACTIVE

steps.name: 4. Donation
steps.expected: Donor donasi; pembayaran QRIS/VA DISUBSTITUSI QRIS mock; webhook SETTLED → donasi PAID
steps.actual: Donasi db8bff71-66e5-4d33-bb7c-0e8a475fe49a Rp100.000; webhook mock SETTLED (audit PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_RECEIVED) → PAID

steps.name: 5. Blockchain
steps.expected: Canonical payload v1 → Keccak-256 → antre → relayer submit → txHash tersimpan (CONFIRMED)

steps.name: 6. Transparency
steps.expected: Donasi, nominal, status verifikasi VERIFIED/COCOK, txHash tampil; explorer Sepolia DISUBSTITUSI chain lokal (tanpa link Etherscan)
steps.actual: COCOK (match=true, integrityStatus=VERIFIED); txHash tampil; etherscanUrl=null (chain lokal)

steps.name: 7. Tamper Simulation
steps.expected: Rp100.000 → Rp900.000 di DB; integrity checker → TAMPERED; campaign FROZEN; pencairan LOCKED
steps.actual: TAMPERED (verifikasi admin), campaign FROZEN, pengajuan pencairan → 409 CAMPAIGN_FROZEN

steps.name: 8. Disbursement (campaign normal)
steps.expected: Creator ajukan + unggah bukti → admin approve → mark paid (PAID)
steps.actual: Pencairan Rp100.000 di campaign normal: REQUESTED → APPROVED → PAID (milestone 1/1)
